arguments.code:
gmail_pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='gmail'][0]
login=apis.gmail.login(username='jefsmith@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw)
access_token=login['access_token']

# Marcus email from phone contact exact match Marcus Smith
phone_pw=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
phone_token=apis.phone.login(username='3272301258', password=phone_pw)['access_token']
all_contacts=[]; page_index=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='Marcus', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_contacts.extend(page)
    if len(page)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1
candidates=[c for c in all_contacts if str(c.get('first_name','')).lower()=='marcus']
marcus_email=[c['email'] for c in candidates][0]
print('marcus_email', marcus_email)

# search inbox threads (incoming) with attachments from marcus
inbox=[]; page_index=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(access_token=access_token, from_email=marcus_email, attachment=True, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    inbox.extend(resp)
    if len(resp)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1
print('inbox_threads', len(inbox))

# search archived threads with attachments from marcus
archived=[]; page_index=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.gmail.show_archived_threads(access_token=access_token, from_email=marcus_email, attachment=True, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    archived.extend(resp)
    if len(resp)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1
print('archived_threads', len(archived))

# union thread ids
thread_ids=sorted(set([t['email_thread_id'] for t in inbox]+[t['email_thread_id'] for t in archived]))
print('unique_thread_ids', thread_ids)
for tid in thread_ids:
    th=apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=access_token)
    attachments=[]
    for em in th.get('emails',[]):
        for a in em.get('attachments',[]):
            attachments.append((em.get('subject'), a.get('id'), a.get('file_name')))
    print('\nThread', tid, 'attachments:', attachments)
